query: How do I make a braided friendship bracelet?

goal.title: Make a black yarn friendship bracelet
goal.description: Draw black yarn from a skein and cut several matching lengths. Gather and knot the strands, trim their ends, and tape the knotted end to the tabletop. Repeatedly cross and tighten the loose strands into a braid, tie the free end, trim excess yarn, and remove the bracelet from the tape.
goal.final_state: A finished black braided loop with short loose ends is lifted and placed on the table near the video end.
procedure: Pull yarn from the skein and cut the first length.
Match and cut additional yarn lengths.
Gather the strands and knot one end.
Trim loose ends and tape the knot to the table.
Cross the loose strands repeatedly and pull the braid taut.
Knot the free end and trim excess yarn.
Peel the bracelet from its tape anchor, inspect it, and set it down.

phases.description: Unwind black yarn, stretch it against the cut strand, and use scissors to prepare matching lengths.
Measure the strands together, cut them, gather their ends into a knot, and trim protruding yarn.
Retrieve the dispenser, pull out clear tape, and press the gathered yarn end against the tabletop.
Alternately cross black strands over the center and pull them taut, repeatedly shifting the grip down the growing braid.
Tie the yarn at the braid end, cut excess strands, and begin loosening the taped anchor.
